items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: But you quit him and you taken all that from him, you see? And we went with you.

ctx.x: Did you play with Jack any?

Huh? You played with Jack some time, huh? Jack? Oh yeah. Yeah, I remember his band when you remember. But you quit him and you taken all that from him, you see? And we went with you. And you know how the two down there was Linton come saying that's bad, well that's how it broke us up, you see? And then we got together and we worked with different other fellas. That's what broke his bad enough, you know? Yeah, I had a job in the country for Austin and Johnny Henry. And then it was Crowback. And he couldn't come to…

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Well, Dick, I'm asking the question. Look, Dad, did always, before I come in, did you always have bands behind fumes here?

ctx.x: I said, I don't have buddy Bowden, say,

I don't think what the fuck about taking away. Oh, yeah. And I got that after, you know, I was around about 10, 11 years old when I heard that, you know. I didn't know buddy, you know, until my buddy come in there and got married when I worked for that beer for him, you know. Well, Dick, I'm asking the question. Look, Dad, did always, before I come in, did you always have bands behind fumes here? Always, eh? Yeah. Always did. Always did, yeah. Then when they leave, they used to play diddly-lamour, you know. Yeah,…
We asked him about bass players, some of the good bass players.

items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-11
items.q: Do you know some of them places where me and you and Jack Kerr worked?

ctx.x: You gotta come take your trink out. Yeah, you know it's water though.

Do you know some of them places where me and you and Jack Kerr worked? I can't remember any of them, did you? Where who? When we was with Jack Kerr. Oh man, we used to work. All those places, we used to work for Captain Powell. You remember him? Yeah. Out in front of town, out in front of town. Yeah, that's right. Yeah. Turn down at the Benitez Hall. And then Kelly people, you know. All different halls. National Park? Yeah, National Park there and uh. Willow. Yeah. And uh. What about Highman Park? We used to get…
